weather_report:
As night surrenders its grip on Downtown San Francisco, a gentle veil of clouds swathes the city, cradling temperatures around a mild 57 degrees. The southwest winds whisper softly, stirring the air just enough to hint at the day to come, a subtle promise of clarity. As dawn approaches and the sun gradually awakens, the forecast foretells the joyful emergence of bright, sunny skies, lifting spirits as temperatures climb to a comfortable 68 degrees. The winds will dance playfully from the west-southwest, carrying with them a gentle vigor.

Though a marine layer may linger along the coast, casting a soft, misty embrace around the Great Golden Gate, the heart of the city is poised to bask in luminous light. As you step outside, a light jacket could serve as a warmly welcomed companion, particularly for the early risers who appreciate the refreshing kiss of morning air. Venture along the Embarcadero or take a leisurely stroll through Golden Gate Park, where the sights of blooming flora under the gentle sun will invite you to indulge in the beauty of a serene Saturday. The day stretches out, beckoning you to savor a cup of coffee at a quaint café or explore the artful streets, where even the mundane feels extraordinary beneath a glimmering sky.
